notes.title: Cozy Crest Update v0.6
notes.notes:
I hope you’re all doing fantastic! I have some exciting news to share with you today. I've been working hard on the game and trailer, and I'm thrilled to announce that new update is now Live! and I've decided to add some amazing new features!

Demo Updates:

🆕 The latest update is now live! It includes all the recent changes, so be sure to check out ⁠in [url=https://discord.gg/YBduQdEHzk]discord[/url] for the details.

Next up is the character customization system, allowing you to see your unique characters in-game. We’ll continue rotating different demos to test various systems before the official release.

Game Scope:

I've decided to broaden the game’s scope and bring in additional hires. Here’s what you can expect in Cozy Crest:

🌍 Biomes: A larger open world with diverse landscapes.
🐾 Pets: You can cuddle, teach new moves, and take them on your adventures.
💑 NPCs: Enhanced personalities, love interests, and story lines for the 12 dateable characters.
🎉 World Events: Random events around player characters to keep world exploration exciting.
🎮 Mini Games: Fishing, cooking, catching pets, gliding, and clan-based challenges.

Game Release Date:

📅 I’ll likely move the release date forward to polish the game further and incorporate all the cool features mentioned above. However, you can always get the latest alpha build on 

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/CozyCrest

which directly supports the game and provides you access to latest alpha build!

Thank you for being the best supporters of Cozy Crest. Have a wonderful day! ☀️

notes.title: Cozy Crest Update v0.55
notes.notes:
[b]New Features :[/b]


Added ability to interact with apple trees gain apples from them and consume it, consuming the item will restore energy 
Added Strawberry bushes that will appear during Spring you can interact with them and gain strawberry consuming it will restore energy 
Added Iron ore veins around the world, large, medium, small veins
 

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements :[/b]

Player no longer get stuck in the doorway 
Quest UI no longer fade out after progressing on tasks
Starting stamina is doubled (from 120 to 240)
You now get a warning when you don't have enough stamina to use tools
Using tools like Axe / Pickaxe without hitting resources no longer cost energy 
Scythe no longer limited to single use on grass you can keep going around cutting smaller grass
Added a large ocean covering the island to smooth up the transition from afar
Updated & added few items & icons (Berries, Iron Ore, Fiber, Apple)
Plotted land no longer rotated / crooked 
Plotted lands beside each other no longer overlap 
Removed hidden collision object near the house prevent player from farming around
Grass no longer grows on plotted land after plotting
Fixed an issue with the player falling under water and breaking controls sometime 
In-game menu will now pause the game
Quest dialogue no longer auto plays you have to press a button to proceed 
Going to sleep no longer gets the player out of the capsule 
minor graphical glitches fixes

[b]Controller :[/b]

Start button now opens main menu
Select button hides UI 
Circle Now allows use to use tools as well no longer using R2 for tools
